title: Kickoff — Design Themes & Workflow Discovery
format: On-site working session — mockup review + live process walkthrough
tldr: First working session. Top Rock walked the shop through five website design theme directions (adventure, trusted, dark/bold, clean, plus one more mockup) for the shop to pick from, then spent most of the meeting on a deep discovery of how the business actually runs. The core pain: every online course signup is a slow, error-prone, manual relay between RentItBiz (where customers book), Lightspeed (the source of truth for inventory, revenue, and e-learning codes), Google Calendar (class roster), and Gmail templates (onboarding email with the e-learning code + waivers). Agreed approach: chunk the problems — take over the class/scheduling flow first and replace RentItBiz for courses, keep Lightspeed as the system of record, and automate the customer-create / e-learning-code-assign / onboarding-email steps via APIs. Rentals are deferred but the long-term goal is to retire RentItBiz entirely. The owner separately asked for a new Pacific Scuba Repair website (national advertising; protect their strong SEO/AI discoverability) and flagged that the old site's domain access and a lost contact form are blockers. Rough pricing floated: ~$500 mock website (250 deposit), ~$100–150/mo to replace RentItBiz, add-ons quoted separately in a forthcoming statement of work.

actionItems.action: Review the theme mockups and pick a design direction.
Provide the Lightspeed rep contact + API access.
Send samples of each class onboarding email / Gmail template.
Get the Pacific domain login / access (and old site files if possible) from the California contact.
Be available to confirm sandbox changes via text as Top Rock prototypes in Lightspeed.
Send the theme mockups to the shop.
Email the owner his homework list.
Draft the statement of work (deliverables + monthly pricing for add-ons).
Investigate the Lightspeed API and prototype create-customer / assign-course / pull-and-assign-code in a labeled sandbox.
Create the Test customer, Test e-learning code, and fake course in Lightspeed for safe testing.
Design the checkout-time waiver/medical signing + automated onboarding email (explore SMS).
Plan the new Pacific Scuba Repair site (SEO-safe, AI optimization, DNS repoint once access lands).
